sources.title: GitHub - yeliu84/pi-model-router: Extension for the pi coding agent ...
sources.snippet: Smart per-turn model router extension for the pi-coding-agent that optimizes your AI budget and usage limits without sacrificing quality by dynamically routing each turn to the optimal LLM tier. It automatically selects between high, medium, and low-tier models based on task intent, session budget, context size, and custom rules — complete with automatic fallbacks and phase awareness.
